hero.title: Elevate your precious moments through floral art
hero.subtitle: Bespoke floral art by Laëtitia Schaeffer, from Paris to the French Riviera
hero.quote: Flowers are the smiles of the earth.

intro.title: Floral art, a story of passion
intro.description: From her Parisian studio, Laëtitia Schaeffer envisions and crafts unique floral creations. Every project is an encounter, every bouquet tells a story. With Boticia, your events come alive through flowers.

features.title: Floral art at the service of your emotions
features.feature_1_description: We prioritize locally grown French flowers for unmatched freshness and a reduced environmental footprint.
features.feature_2_description: Every arrangement is unique, designed and handcrafted to match your vision, theme and venue.
features.feature_3_description: Sustainable practices at every step: seasonal flowers, zero synthetic floral foam, reusable supports.

pricing.title: All-inclusive packages for your wedding
pricing.plan_2_summary: Bridal bouquet, boutonnieres, table centrepieces, welcome sign and venue visit included. Everything you need for a complete and harmonious floral decoration.
pricing.plan_3_summary: Complete artistic direction, bespoke scenography, setup and day-of coordination. For those who dream of an exceptional floral event.

process.title: Three steps to your floral decoration
process.step_1_description: We discuss your project, your wishes and your world during a free, no-obligation first meeting.
process.step_2_description: We design a bespoke proposal with a moodboard, a floral palette and a detailed quote tailored to your budget.
process.step_3_description: Our team carefully installs each arrangement to enhance your venue and create the atmosphere you've been dreaming of.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How far in advance should I book?
faq.a1: We recommend reaching out 6 to 12 months before your event, especially for weddings during peak season (May to September).
faq.q2: Do you only use French flowers?
faq.a2: We prioritize seasonal French flowers sourced locally. Depending on your wishes, we can thoughtfully incorporate select imported varieties.
faq.a3: Yes, we travel across all of France for your events. Travel fees may apply depending on the distance.
faq.q4: How does a first consultation work?
faq.a4: Get in touch by email or phone. We discuss your project, your wishes and your budget during a free, no-obligation first meeting.

about.tagline: Shall we get to know each other?
about.title: About me
about.intro: I'm Laëtitia, a floral designer with a deep passion for flowers. Three years ago, I founded Boticia with one idea in mind: creating unique, modern and meaningful floral scenographies.
about.value_1: Bespoke compositions that reflect who you are
about.value_2: Locally sourced French flowers, committed and responsible
about.value_3: A caring, attentive guidance at your own pace
about.approach: I love taking the time to understand your world, to listen to you and to imagine together a floral decoration that will elevate your special day. Here, no standardised creations — every project is a true collaboration.
about.anecdote: I'm like the tortoise in the fable: I start slow, but once I get going, nothing can stop me!
about.cta_text: Dreaming of a floral scenography with style and meaning?
